thread:
Maria Chen: quick heads-up — I finished the initial cloud project + VNet scaffold for the new SFO2 GPU workload. Project: redwood-sfo2-gpu-01. Created subnets: control 10.40.0.0/20, gpu 10.40.16.0/20, mgmt 10.40.32.0/24. Need someone to run the validation checklist (quotas, routes, firewall, peerings, nat gateways) and confirm it's safe to hand off to platforms. target deploy window 16:00 PT today. assigning @Deepa for quota checks and @Jake for routing/peering. :rocket:

Jake O'Neill: ack — I'll start with VPC peering and route tables. do we have a preferred egress NAT sizing for bursty pulls?

Maria Chen: thanks. expecting moderate egress during image pulls, start with 2x m5.large NAT instances behind an NLB, we can scale if needed. also ensure ephemeral IP availability for nodes.

Deepa Patel: looking at quotas now. GPUs in sfo2 show limited availability in our quota ledger — current GPU quota 8 (all zones). request submitted to cloud quota team for +32 (request id Q-20240507-844). ETA usually 24–48h but we can request expedited.

Oliver Ramos: note on naming — control plane RG uses prefix rwd-sfo2-ctrl, compute uses rwd-sfo2-gpu, tagging set to team:inference, env:staging. also added flow logs on control subnet — retention 7d.

Jake O'Neill: route check — peering to prod-vpc-ok done, propagation enabled. but saw overlapping CIDR with a legacy project (10.40.8.0/21). We should shrink gpu subnet to avoid collision or renumber. any objections to moving gpu to 10.41.0.0/20 instead?

Maria Chen: not ideal this late but prefer to avoid collision. ok to renumber gpu to 10.41.0.0/20. please update terraform and reapply in the next 30m.

infra-bot: terraform plan for modules/vpc
```
~ module.vpc.google_compute_subnetwork.gpu: resource will be replaced
  - cidr_range: "10.40.16.0/20" -> "10.41.0.0/20"
Plan: 1 to add, 1 to change, 1 to destroy.
```

Jake O'Neill: applied change locally, pushed branch feature/sfo2-vpc-cidr-fix. CI passed. can someone run a quick smoke apply in staging? @deploy-bot?

deploy-bot: scheduled apply job #4532 in staging at 2024-05-07T15:12:00Z. will post results here.

deploy-bot: apply succeeded. Created subnets, updated route tables, established peering.

Deepa Patel: quotas — cloud approved expedited GPU quota increase to 40 (ETA ~2 hours). filed tracking ticket INFRA-622. Please don't start large-scale provisioning until quota shows in console.

Oliver Ramos: security checks — firewall rules added: allow SSH from bastion only (rwd-bastion-sfo2), allow K8s control plane ports 6443 and 10250 from control subnet, deny 0.0.0.0/0 for node management. added NACLs to block known noisy IP ranges.

Maria Chen: great. final pre-handoff checklist: 1) quotas visible (Deepa) 2) peering/routes confirmed (Jake) 3) CIDR adjusted (done) 4) firewall + flow logs (Oliver) 5) tf state uploaded to backend and lock (Jake). anyone else?

Jake O'Neill: tf state pushed and lock confirmed.

Deepa Patel: quota now reflected in console — GPUs 40. good to proceed after you folks sign off.

Maria Chen: ok I'm handing off to platforms for node onboarding. attaching runbook link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/INFRA/pages/SFO2+GPU+Onboard. make sure node bootstrap uses image redwood-gpu-ubuntu-202405. I'll follow up post-provisioning to monitor cost impact. :money_with_wings:

Oliver Ramos: noted — I'll watch VPC egress and NAT utilization. set a cost alert threshold 5000 USD/month for this project for first week.

Maria Chen: thanks team. leaving this thread open for any post-handoff issues. :thumbsup:
